instruction: I need Chrome to provide enhanced protection against dangerous sites. Please enable Enhanced Safe Browsing for maximum security.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

mkdir -p /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && if [ ! -f /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ]; then echo '{}' > /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences; fi && cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"safebrowsing":{"enabled":false,"enhanced":false}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Enhanced Safe Browsing in Chrome settings. Verified that the getter reads from safebrowsing.enhanced field in Preferences.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the 'safebrowsing.enhanced' field from Chrome Preferences file, which is the exact setting for Enhanced Safe Browsing
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are written to disk before verification
Metric 'exact_match' is appropriate for boolean true/false verification
Expected value 'true' correctly matches what the getter returns when Enhanced Safe Browsing is enabled
Getter handles multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux) with correct file paths
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling Enhanced Safe Browsing, evaluator checks exactly that requirement
No semantic or logical issues detected in the verification flow
